CheckTitle: Ensure SoD Across Fusion and EPM Is Monitored
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
SubSectionName: Application Business User Separation of Duties (SoD)
RequiredAccess: Fusion Applications Security Console / Audit Reports (IT Security Manager)
EPM Cloud access (EPM Automate, Service Administrator)
Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management (Advanced Controls)
Description: Users holding conflicting combinations across Fusion and EPM (for example an EPM reconciliation superuser who can also enter journals) should be monitored.
Risk: Cross-application conflicts let one person both transact and reconcile.
AuditProcedure: Identify users with conflicting combinations across both applications.
Automated alternative: deploy the matching Transaction/Access Controls in Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management so changes start an investigation workflow. Examples: 4601-4615.

Steps: Remove unwanted assignments or monitor the users' transactions.
Review the affected transactions in Tools > Reports and Analytics, or monitor them continuously with Risk Management Transaction Controls.
